name: inert quoted deletion
rationale: Printing literal shell-looking text does not execute it.

name: inert printf deletion
rationale: A literal printf argument is data.

name: shell prints inert deletion
rationale: The nested shell runs echo, with deletion text as data.

name: nested shell deletes root
rationale: The literal nested shell program requests root deletion.

name: literal eval deletion
rationale: Eval interprets its literal argument as shell source.

name: cat credential after delimiter
rationale: The delimiter preserves .env as a credential file operand.

name: head credential byte count
rationale: A byte limit still reads credential contents.

name: tail credential starting line
rationale: A starting line still reads credential contents.

name: grep credential pattern file
rationale: The pattern-file option opens credential contents.

name: sort credential file
rationale: Sorting reads and prints credential contents.

name: rg credential-looking pattern
rationale: The .env token is a literal pattern; the input file is ordinary.

name: rg inline credential-looking pattern
rationale: The inline pattern does not open .env.

name: rg credential metadata
rationale: Files mode lists names rather than matching file contents.

name: rg credential ignore file
rationale: The ignore-file option reads .env contents.

name: rg inline helper disabled
rationale: The later no-pre option disables preprocessing.

name: rg helper enabled last
rationale: The later pre option enables an unresolved executable helper.

name: rg ordinary patterns credential input
rationale: An ordinary pattern file does not remove the credential input read.

name: rg files mode skips preprocessor
rationale: Files mode lists paths and does not preprocess search contents.

name: git credential output file
rationale: The output option can overwrite a credential-classified file.

name: git no-index credential read
rationale: No-index compares explicit file contents, including .env.

name: git configured executable pager
rationale: Inline Git configuration can select executable helper behavior.

name: SQL second statement drops table
rationale: A later SQL statement drops a table.

name: SQL semicolon in string
rationale: The semicolon and DROP text are inside one string; remote query effects remain unresolved.

name: SQL quoted keyword identifier
rationale: A quoted column identifier does not establish a DROP statement.

name: SQL data-modifying CTE
command: psql -c 'WITH gone AS (DELETE FROM accounts RETURNING *) SELECT * FROM gone'
rationale: The CTE executes an unfiltered delete even though the outer statement is SELECT.

name: SQL unconditional true predicate
rationale: A constant true predicate selects every row; it does not constrain deletion.

name: SQL unconditional equality predicate
rationale: A constant true equality selects every row.

name: SQL non-executing explain option
rationale: ANALYZE FALSE requests an execution plan without executing the DELETE.

name: SQLite shell metacommand
rationale: The SQLite CLI metacommand executes a shell deletion payload.

name: SQLite extension loading
rationale: Loading an extension can execute unresolved native code.

name: psql shell metacommand
rationale: The psql shell metacommand executes its shell payload.

name: psql credential script input
rationale: The script-file option opens credential-classified contents.
